question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH year_last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT ylr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN year_last_race ylr ON ds.race_id = ylr.last_race_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
best_constructor AS (
    SELECT ylr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN year_last_race ylr ON cs.race_id = ylr.last_race_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT bd.year, 
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
       bd.points AS driver_points,
       c.name AS constructor_name,
       bc.points AS constructor_points
FROM best_driver bd
JOIN best_constructor bc ON bd.year = bc.year
JOIN drivers d ON bd.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON bc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE bd.year >= 2010
ORDER BY bd.year
